title: Erdős Matching Conjecture
exact_target: How large can a uniform family of sets be when it contains no s pairwise disjoint members? The conjecture gives two competing sharp constructions.

sources.citation: Frankl, Lu, Ma and Wu, Towards the Erdős matching conjecture for 4-uniform hypergraphs, Conjecture1.1; substitute q=s-1 in their matching-number convention.
